max_gross 0.9 and weight cap 0.4 are interpolations, not tested arms.
judgement_calls: max_gross 0.9 vs 1.0: record says only that more gross raises P(clear) and lowers Sharpe; 0.9 is a hedge, 1.0 is defensible given the operator go-all-in and top-20 cut near 0-3%.

target_lock on: the operator turned it off to keep +20k reachable; record supports on for qualification (cap cuts P(>15%) 0.09->0.02). Turn on only if the objective is qualifying first; consider lock at +5% only once hit.
block_diversify false: pick-across-blocks is untested live and correlation-cap/decorrelation tests were null, yet 3 names in one block is one bet; the paper blocks|30m arm should decide.
drawdown_brake null: no tested brake passes; existing 25% max_drawdown kill switch remains the only protection, which is a disaster stop not a brake.
